items.title: AXA XL appoints Anita Mirzaian as Executive Underwriter, Media Liability
items.summary: AXA XL has named Anita Mirzaian as Executive Underwriter for Media Liability in Los Angeles, adding more than two decades of specialty underwriting experience to the team.
